feedback: No race has been run for this candidate, so nothing here states its outcome. Evidence so far: iteration 0 (five sensors, x ±0.024 m) gave max_error 0.0626 to 0.0703 m and 1 to 2 line-loss events per run. Iteration 1 (seven sensors, x ±0.036 m, kp 6.0) kept max_error at 0.062 to 0.068 m with about 1 line-loss event per run, and steering oscillation stayed low at 0.11 to 0.23. So widening the sensor span did not remove the off-track exits, and the next race should be read with that in mind. Your proposed wheel_track 0.14 m needs a note: from the contract, turn rate = wheel speed difference / wheel_track, so a wider track gives less yaw per unit of turn command, not more authority. I have compensated by raising kp from 6.0 to 7.0 in the controller; please do not treat wheel_track as the fix for turn authority by itself. Next race: if max_error is still above 0.06 m on s-bend or slalom while steering_oscillation stays below about 0.25, move the forward sensor row from y = 0.04 m to y = 0.03 m (keeping x ±0.036 m), citing iteration 1's low oscillation as evidence there is room for less look-ahead lag. If steering_oscillation rises above about 0.25 with mass 0.5 kg, restore mass to 0.6 kg, citing iteration 0 and 1 oscillation of 0.13 to 0.25 at that mass. If line_loss_events stay at 1 or more on any track after this race, change sensor_size to 0.016 m with the same seven x positions, since iteration 1 showed the tape was still lost at the edges with 0.012 m footprints.
